svg.title: How a failed job of the Action test explains itself
svg.desc: Each part of a job of the Action test runs also when one before it failed. When a part failed, the last step of the job asks blueprint.py for the explanation of each part that failed, from .github/checks.project.toml, and writes it into the summary of the check and as its annotation. After the checks, the PR coach reads the annotations from the API and keeps one comment on the pull request up to date, also on a pull request from a fork, with what failed, why it matters and the commands that run the part on your machine.
